title: erigeron consanguineus
intro: Erigeron consanguineus, commonly known as the coastal Daisy or Bebb's daisy, is a perennial wildflower native to the Pacific coastal regions of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Erigeron consanguineus include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-bacterial and antioxidant effects.
